senses.gloss:
अहु अहु, उस्, वी, उ, (in compounds) narrow.
See अंहु.

आहु आ-हु, cl. 3. P. A. -जुहोते, -जुहुते, -हो-
तुम्, to sacrifice, to offer an oblation, to worship.

अहुत अ-हुत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हु), unsacri-
ficed, unoffered, not yet sacrificed; one who has
not received any sacrifice; not gained or obtained by
sacrifice; (अस्), m. religious meditation, prayer, and
study of the Veda, considered as one of the five great
sacraments, otherwise called Brahma-yajña.
—अ-हुताद्
(˚त-अद्), त्, त्, त्, Ved. not eating of a sacrifice; not
allowed to partake of a sacrifice.

अहूत अ-हूत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ह्वे), uncalled, un-
summoned, unchallenged. (The form अ-हुत with the
sense ‘uncalled,’ given by Wilson, is very questionable.)

आ-हुत, अम्, n. an offering made to men, hospi-
tality; the nourishment of all created beings con-
sidered as one of the five sacraments or principal
sacrifices of the Hindūs.

2. आ-हूत, अस्, आ, अम्, called, summoned, invoked,
invited.
—आहूत-प्रपलायिन्, ई, m. a defendant or
witness absconding or not appearing when summoned.

1. आ-हुति, इस्, f. offering oblations with fire to the
deities; any solemn rite accompanied with oblations:
(for 2. आ-हुति see under आ-ह्वे.)
—आहुती-वृध्, त्,
त्, त्, Ved. delighting in sacrifices.

2. आ-हुति, calling, invoking. (This word may
sometimes have this sense in the oldest Vedic texts,
but see the more correct form आ-हूति. For 1. आ-
हुति see under आ-हु last col.)

आहुक आहुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince, great-
grandfather of Kṛṣṇa, a son or grandson of Abhi-
jit; (ई), f. a sister of this prince; (आस्), m. pl., N. of
a people.

आहुल्य आहुल्य, अम्, n., N. of the legumi-
nous shrub Tabernæmontana Coronaria.

आ-हूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be bent down or
brought near; to be made favourable, one towards
whom one must bow; (Sāy.) to be invoked (fr. rt.
ह्वे).
आ-हुव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) to be invoked.
